name: Nightfall

components.pose: She stands at the edge of her homeland as the last light goes, with golden light and drifting motes gathered low in one open hand like a lantern that lights her face, looking to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Golden light and drifting motes light the land around her and {{MAGIC}} light glows warm against the dark.

notes: REALM SERIES: Nightfall in her light homeland (night); realistic, from realms/light-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/light.
